treatment_summary: Start ramipril and atorvastatin as first‑line CKD therapy per NICE NG203, add amlodipine if BP remains above target, replace metformin with basal insulin for diabetes, and address CKD‑related anemia with IV iron followed by epoetin alfa if needed. All drugs are chosen considering eGFR = 10.9 mL/min/1.73 m², avoiding contraindicated agents (metformin, SGLT2 inhibitors, NSAIDs, ACE‑I/ARB combo). Monitoring of potassium, creatinine, liver enzymes, glucose, iron parameters, and hemoglobin is required as outlined.
